# Cluster multivariate observations by Gaussian finite mixture modeling

Cluster prediction for multivariate observations based on Gaussian
finite mixture models estimated by
[`Mclust`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mclust/reference/Mclust.md).

## Usage

``` r
# S3 method for class 'Mclust'
predict(object, newdata, ...)
```

## Arguments

- object:

  an object of class `'Mclust'` resulting from a call to
  [`Mclust`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mclust/reference/Mclust.md).

- newdata:

  a data frame or matrix giving the data. If missing the clustering data
  obtained from the call to
  [`Mclust`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mclust/reference/Mclust.md)
  are classified.

- ...:

  further arguments passed to or from other methods.

## Value

Returns a list of with the following components:

- classification:

  a factor of predicted cluster labels for `newdata`.

- z:

  a matrix whose *\[i,k\]*th entry is the probability that observation
  *i* in `newdata` belongs to the *k*th cluster.

## Author

Luca Scrucca

## See also

[`Mclust`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mclust/reference/Mclust.md).

## Examples

``` r
model <- Mclust(faithful)

# predict cluster for the observed data
pred <- predict(model) 
str(pred)
#> List of 2
#>  $ classification: int [1:272] 1 2 1 2 3 2 3 1 2 3 ...
#>  $ z             : num [1:272, 1:3] 9.72e-01 8.12e-13 9.97e-01 3.06e-07 1.17e-02 ...
#>   ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. ..$ : NULL

pred$z              # equal to model$z
```
